more.good_when: A colleague whose Price or Quantity column was formatted as text, so that Calc shows 100.00 or 2 just as a number, is told that the cell holds text and how to make it a number in Calc. Today they read "holds \"100.00\", not a number; enter the price as a number, such as 12.50" or "holds \"2\" ... enter how many, such as 2", and are stuck, since they did enter a number. A colleague whose price cells are in another currency, such as $100.00 in USD, is stopped before printing, not handed an invoice that reads 200 EUR. A colleague whose price is a formula that Calc shows as 33.33 is stopped, or gets the 33.33 they see, not an invoice that prints 33.3333333333333 EUR and a total of 39.6633333333333 EUR.
